data.text:
Suresh Mk vs Food Safety Officer on 6 June, 2024 
Author: T.R.Ravi
Bench: T.R.Ravi
Wp(C) No.38590/2023 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice T.R.Ravi
 Thursday, the 6th day of June 2024 / 16th Jyaishta, 1946
 Wp(C) No. 38590 Of 2023 (W)
 Petitioners:
 1. SURESH M.K., AGED 55 YEARS, S/O M.G. KRISHANAN, MADIYATHAZHATH  HOUSE, CHITTTOOR P.O., PIN - 682027  AND 3 OTHERS  RESPONDENTS:
 1. FOOD SAFETY OFFICER, PERUMBAVOOR CIRCLE, SUB-TREASURY COMPOUND,
 PERUMBAVOOR, PIN - 683542  AND 3 OTHERS  Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to stay Ext.P1 order, pending final disposal of this Writ  Petition. 
 This petition again coming on for admission upon perusing the  petition and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and this Court's  order dated 02.04.2024 and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.P.THOMAS  GEEVERGHESE, TONY THOMAS (INCHIPARAMBIL), E.S.FIROS, SRADHA MOHAN &
 AMRUTHA K.P., Advocates for the petitioners and of GOVERNMENT PLEADER for  Respondents, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Interim order is extended by three months.
Sd/- T.R.RAVI, JUDGE 06-06-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Suresh Mk vs Food Safety Officer on 6 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102901714/
1
